metadata.label: Run Austin Permits Actor
metadata.note: Calls the permits actor synchronously and returns the dataset items array directly as this module's 'data' output. Paste your Apify API token into the Authorization header value (Bearer <token>) or wire it through a Make connection/data store.

metadata.label: Iterate dataset items
metadata.note: Built-in Flow Control > Iterator. Fires once per array item so the downstream HTTP call runs per-item instead of once for the whole batch. Ships with every Make plan; no connection needed.

metadata.label: Post Contractor to Slack (per item, filter to non-empty phone in the mapper below)
metadata.note: Calls Slack's Web API directly (chat.postMessage) so no separate Make Slack app connection is required — only a Slack Bot Token with chat:write scope in the Authorization header. Add a Filter on the connector between module 2 and module 3 (condition: contractor_phone is not empty) so only rows with a dialable number post. Add Make's built-in duplicate-prevention (a Data Store keyed on contractor_phone + permit_number, checked before this module) if you want the same not-already-posted behavior as the n8n version.

notes: Schedule: this blueprint has no schedule encoded (Make stores scenario scheduling outside the blueprint). After import, click the clock icon on the scenario and set it to run daily.
Replace {{connection.apifyToken}}, {{connection.slackBotToken}} / Airtable token, and all REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders before running.

Module ids: http:ActionSendData is Make's generic HTTP module (very stable across accounts). builtin:BasicFeeder is the built-in Iterator. Both are used here instead of the native Apify/Slack/Airtable Make apps so this file imports cleanly without a live Make account to verify native-app module versions against; swap in the native apps afterward for a nicer point-and-click UI if you prefer.
